steps.do: Greet the customer politely and acknowledge the declined card or cards. Say you will verify their identity before looking at the accounts.
steps.quote: Generally, for any scenario involving accessing customer information in internal databases, you must first verify their identify before proceeding.

steps.do: Ask for the customer's name (or email) plus any two of: date of birth, email, phone number, address.
steps.if: the customer has not been verified yet in this conversation
steps.quote: ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Look up the customer record with the tool that matches what the customer gave: get_user_information_by_name (the name is case sensitive), get_user_information_by_email or get_user_information_by_id.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or the email / user id, with the matching tool)

steps.if: the customer has not been verified yet in this conversation
steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools

steps.do: Compare the values the customer gave with the record. Continue only if at least 2 of date of birth, email, phone number and address match. If they do not match, say you cannot verify the customer, share nothing about the accounts, and stop.
steps.quote: Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

steps.do: Get the current time. It is needed for the verification log and to tell which withdrawals were made 'today'.
steps.quote: If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.

steps.do: Log the verification with the values from the verified record and the current time.
steps.if: identity was verified in check_identity and has not already been logged in this conversation
steps.quote: After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Unlock each of get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 and get_bank_account_transactions_9173, once each.
steps.if: the tool has not already been unlocked in this conversation
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get all of the verified user's bank accounts. Match each declined card to its checking account by account_class, and note the account_id, status, balance and date_opened.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: If several cards were declined, handle them one at a time, starting with the card the customer picks. For the card being handled, ask how much they tried to withdraw if they have not said.
steps.if: the order of the cards or the attempted amount for the current card is not yet known

steps.do: Look up the debit cards on the checking account linked to the card being handled. Use the current card (not CLOSED) and read card_id, status, daily_atm_limit, daily_purchase_limit and, if present, daily_atm_used.

arguments.account_id: account_id from get_accounts for the card being handled

steps.quote: Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to look up all debit cards associated with a specific checking account.

steps.do: Get the transaction history of the same checking account. Find today's atm_withdrawal transactions (dated the same day as get_time) and any overdraft_fee transactions.

arguments.account_id: account_id from get_accounts for the card being handled

steps.quote: Agents can retrieve the transaction history for a customer's bank account (checking or savings) using the get_bank_account_transactions_9173 tool.

steps.do: Before blaming the limit, check the card status and the account status. If the account is not OPEN, tell the customer only that the account has a restriction, and give the branch and 1-800-RHO-ACCT. If the card is FROZEN, PENDING or CLOSED, tell the customer the card cannot be used as it is, and follow debit_card_decline_code_05_do_not_honor for it. A limit increase cannot fix either case. Otherwise continue.
steps.quote: Your account has a restriction that is preventing transactions. Please visit a branch or call our dedicated account services line at 1-800-RHO-ACCT for assistance.

steps.do: Compute remaining = daily ATM limit − ATM amount used today. For the limit, use the card's daily_atm_limit. If the card record has no limit field, use the account class's documented limit: Green Account (checking) $600, Blue Account $500, Light Green Account $150. For the amount used, use daily_atm_used, or else add up today's atm_withdrawal amounts. If the attempted amount is more than the remaining amount, the decline is caused by the daily limit (Code 61).
steps.if: the card is ACTIVE and its account is OPEN
steps.quote: daily_atm_used: ATM amount already used today

steps.do: Tell the customer the daily limit, how much has been used today and how much is left. Suggest withdrawing no more than the amount left. If the card record shows no limit field, say so and use the documented limit for the account class.
steps.if: the attempted amount exceeds the remaining daily ATM limit and the account_class is not Light Green Account

steps.do: Explain the $150/day ATM limit, the amount used today and what is left (150 - used)
steps.if: the card being handled is on a Light Green Account
steps.quote: - Cash withdrawals are limited to $150 per day at ATMs.

steps.do: If asked for an increase, explain that the teen limits are fixed safeguards and cannot be raised. Do NOT call the increase tool. Suggest withdrawing over several days or using the parent's card.
steps.quote: For cash needs that exceed $150, plan ahead by withdrawing over multiple days.

steps.do: If the customer needs more than the amount left on a card that is not a Light Green Account card, offer a temporary 24-hour increase. If they accept, or ask for one themselves, run requesting_temporary_debit_card_limit_increase for this card; its eligibility checks decide whether the increase is granted. Mention that a non-Rho ATM may have its own lower limit.
steps.if: the customer needs more than the remaining limit and the account_class is not Light Green Account
steps.quote: Tell customer: 'I can request a temporary increase that lasts 24 hours. Would you like me to do that?'

steps.do: If the customer asks for a permanent increase, explain that permanent increases depend on the account tier and only Elite tier accounts can request them. Offer the temporary 24-hour increase instead. No documented tool makes a permanent increase.
steps.if: the customer asks for a permanent limit increase
steps.quote: **Permanent Increase**: Depends on account tier. Elite tier can request permanent increases.

steps.do: Repeat ask_card_order through offer_increase for each other declined card the customer named. Close only when every card has been addressed.

rules.rule: Light Green Account ATM limit is fixed at $150/day and cannot be increased or removed for a minor
rules.quote: These safeguards are built into the account and cannot be removed for a minor.

rules.rule: Do not change controls on a teen account without the guardian's authorization
rules.quote: Do NOT modify parental controls without the guardian's authorization.

rules.rule: Light Green Account card purchases are capped at $300 per day
rules.quote: Card-based purchases are capped at $300 per day.

rules.rule: Green Account (checking) daily ATM limit is $600, combined across all ATM withdrawals in 24 hours
rules.quote: Your Green Account (checking) debit card has a daily ATM withdrawal limit of $600.

rules.rule: Blue Account daily ATM limit is $500, combined across all ATM withdrawals in 24 hours
rules.quote: Your Blue Account debit card has a daily ATM withdrawal limit of $500. This limit applies to all ATM withdrawals combined (domestic and international) within a 24-hour period.

rules.rule: Remaining = daily limit − amount used today. The decline is a limit decline when the attempted amount is above the remaining amount.

rules.rule: Permanent limit increases depend on the tier (Elite tier only). Otherwise offer only the temporary increase.
rules.quote: **Permanent Increase**: Depends on account tier. Elite tier can request permanent increases.

rules.rule: A non-Rho ATM may have its own lower limit that Rho-Bank cannot override
rules.quote: 3. IMPORTANT: For ATM limits at non-Rho ATMs, the other bank's ATM may have its own lower limit that we cannot override.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged. For every declined card the customer named, the agent has explained either the limit, the amount used today and the amount left, or the status or restriction behind the decline. For a teen Light Green card, the agent has explained the remaining amount and said no increase is possible. For each other card where more was needed, a temporary increase was offered and, if accepted, handled in requesting_temporary_debit_card_limit_increase.
